claims.statement: The EXEC-07 entrypoint invokes the existing complete clean-state journey serially for committed HEAD, overrides an older caller REF and propagates failure. It preserves fresh owned storage, public startup, frozen builds, reseed, replay/restart, offline suites, browser smoke, source reconciliation and scoped cleanup with existing deadlines.

The smoke checks the exact five unique scenario IDs and reviewed write counts before admitting runs. Email evidence requires two zero-attempt actions before approval and after the first approval, followed by one successful delivery per action after both. Read-only substitutes, duplicates and malformed classifications cannot establish success. Replay preserves original evidence and identities without claiming a new preapproval observation.

The actual clean-state command and separate scoped Compose paired-backup round-trip must both succeed against the committed candidate. Focused controls, prior reports or a host-only pass are not replacements. The clean journey retains all nine phases and its 1620-second execution plus 120-second cleanup budgets; backup retains its own unchanged bounds.

A separately observed successful unchanged AC-16 complete 20-gate run must qualify the same committed tree before merge, including full backend/frontend inventories, 17 safety-coverage modules and 16 browser runners. The short audit requires the matching external source-bound record; consistency alone does not authenticate execution.

limitations: Focused controls and a same-tree local record are not independently authenticated execution. The complete committed candidate requires observed successful full quality, actual clean-state and paired-backup executions before requesting merge; reports remain outside Git.

Image/dependency acquisition may contact registries. Backend and prebuilt test containers use network-none, but static web ingress retains a disclosed operating-system outbound route. Browser requests are limited to the exact local origin; this is not an all-container firewall claim.

Qualification targets SQLite, local identity and deterministic mock adapters. Optional PostgreSQL skips do not qualify PostgreSQL, live providers, real external delivery, production authentication, cloud deployment or production RPO/RTO.

Restart replay carries the earlier observed Email preapproval proof and checks durable identities; it does not newly observe preapproval after completed actions. Backup uses only owned synthetic fixture data and test key material.

This is not a literal make acceptance invocation, a fresh AC-15 four-suite kernel-isolation run, DEL-01 completion or EXEC-08 final attestation. CI remains disabled, checkpoints are preserved, and no main merge is authorized by these records.
